note: Set A correctly captures several spanwise values from the plots — twist ≈15° at r/R=0 and ≈0° at r/R=1, chord ≈5 m at the root, and prebend ≈0 m at the root — whereas Set B returns nothing and misses every fact in Figure 2-4. However, A misreads the relative thickness curve badly (claims 21% at the root where the curve is ≈100%, and 15% at the tip where it is ≈21%) and gives 25% pitch-axis chord location at both ends when the plot shows ≈50% at the root and ≈37% at the tip (25% is off-scale). A also drops the sign on tip prebend (−4 m, claimed as +4 m), and its tip chord ≈1 m is only approximate for a steep end drop. Despite roughly half its claims being wrong, A's correct extractions still outweigh B's complete omission.
